notes: Google released lyria-3.5-clip-preview in public preview on 2026-09-03.
Supported inputs are text and image; outputs are MP3 audio and text lyrics.
Lyria 3.5 Clip Preview is optimized for short musical clips, loops, and previews and generates 30-second audio.
Google documents 44.1 kHz stereo audio generation from text prompts or image inputs.
The model is accessed through the Interactions API.

Audio generation is supported; caching, code execution, file search, function calling, Google Maps grounding, image generation, Live API, search grounding, structured outputs, thinking, and URL context are explicitly unsupported.
Batch API, Flex inference, and Priority inference are explicitly unsupported.
Computer-use and MCP support are not declared in the checked model documentation and remain unknown.
